source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 19 (PDF 137-155), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Nuclear and Particle Physics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe briefly how the nucleus and its constituents were discovered. Explain the nuclide symbol ᴬ_Z X and give the sizes of the nucleus and the atom. (5 marks)
(Nucleus aur us ke ajza (constituents) ki daryaft mukhtasar bayan karein. Nuclide symbol ᴬ_Z X ki wazahat karein aur nucleus aur atom ke size batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Daryaft:
• Rutherford ke α-particle scattering tajurbaat (1911) ne aik ghana, positive charge wala bohat chhota markazi hissa (nucleus) dikhaya jis ke gird electrons hain. Atom ka zyada hissa khaali hai aur mass nucleus mein jama hai.
• 1920 mein Rutherford ne kaha ke positive charge nucleus ke protons ki wajah se hai aur aik be-charge particle ki peshgoi ki.
• James Chadwick ne 1932 mein yeh particle, neutron, daryaft kiya.

Nuclide symbol ᴬ_Z X:
• X element ka chemical symbol hai.
• Z atomic (charge) number: protons ki tadaad.
• A mass number: nucleons (protons + neutrons) ki kul tadaad.
• Neutrons N = A − Z.
Misalein: ¹₁H, ¹²₆C, ²³⁵₉₂U.

Size: Nucleus bohat ghana hai, radius 10⁻¹⁴ m ke darje ka; electrons ke badal se atom ka radius 10⁻¹⁰ m ke darje ka hai.

book_ref.quote: In 1920, Rutherford further suggested the positive charge due to protons inside the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
2 For the nuclides ¹³¹₅₃I and ⁵⁹₂₆Fe find (i) the number of protons, (ii) the number of neutrons and (iii) the number of nucleons in each. Also find how many times the atomic radius (10⁻¹⁰ m) is larger than the nuclear radius (10⁻¹⁴ m). (3 marks)
(Nuclides ¹³¹₅₃I aur ⁵⁹₂₆Fe ke liye (i) protons, (ii) neutrons aur (iii) nucleons ki tadaad nikalein. Yeh bhi batayein ke atom ka radius (10⁻¹⁰ m) nucleus ke radius (10⁻¹⁴ m) se kitne guna bara hai.)
blocks.explanation: Protons = Z, nucleons = A, neutrons = A − Z; size ka tanasub seedhi taqseem hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, we write the elements of hydrogen, carbon and uranium as

blocks.final_answer: I-131: 53 p, 78 n, 131 nucleons; Fe-59: 26 p, 33 n, 59 nucleons; atom taqreeban 10⁴ guna bara

blocks.prompt:
3 Define mass defect and binding energy. Write the equation for the mass defect of a nucleus ᴬ_Z X and show how its binding energy is found. Also define binding energy per nucleon and the atomic mass unit. (5 marks)
(Mass defect aur binding energy ki definition likhein. Nucleus ᴬ_Z X ke mass defect ki equation likhein aur dikhayein ke binding energy kaise nikalti hai. Binding energy per nucleon aur atomic mass unit ki definition bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mass defect: Tajurbaat batate hain ke nucleus ka mass hamesha us ke protons aur neutrons ke kul mass se kam hota hai. Yeh gum shuda mass, mass defect Δm hai. Nucleus ᴬ_Z X mein Z protons aur (A − Z) neutrons hain, is liye
Δm = [Zmₚ + (A − Z)mₙ] − m_nucleus ... (19.1)
jahan mₚ proton, mₙ neutron aur m_nucleus poore nucleus ka mass hai.

Binding energy: Gum shuda mass nucleus bante waqt energy mein badal jata hai. Einstein ke relation se
ΔE = (Δm)c² ... (19.2)
Yeh binding energy hai: nucleus ko us ke neutrons aur protons mein todne ke liye kiya gaya kaam. Absolute gravitational potential (infinity par zero) ki tarah bandhe nizaam ke liye ise negative liya jata hai.

Binding energy per nucleon: B.E/A, har nucleon ko alag karne ki ausat energy; stability ka behtar paimana.

Atomic mass unit: 1 u carbon-12 ke aik atom ke mass ka 1/12 hai.
1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁴ g = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg

book_ref.quote: The results of experiments on the masses of different nuclei show

blocks.prompt:
4 The mass of a tritium nucleus ³₁H is 5.007357 × 10⁻²⁷ kg. Find its mass defect, binding energy in MeV and binding energy per nucleon. (mₚ = 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, mₙ = 1.674929 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J) (3 marks)
(Tritium nucleus ³₁H ka mass 5.007357 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai. Is ka mass defect, MeV mein binding energy aur binding energy per nucleon nikalein. (mₚ = 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, mₙ = 1.674929 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J))
blocks.explanation: Tritium mein 1 proton aur 2 neutrons; Eq. 19.1 se Δm, phir B.E = Δmc², eV mein badlein aur A = 3 se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: Find the mass defect and binding energy of the helium nucleus given that

blocks.final_answer: Δm = 1.5124 × 10⁻²⁹ kg; B.E = 8.51 MeV; 2.84 MeV per nucleon

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the graph of binding energy per nucleon against nucleon number. What does it tell about the stability of nuclei, and how does it explain the release of energy in fission and fusion? (5 marks)
(Binding energy per nucleon aur nucleon number ke graph ko bayan karein. Yeh nuclei ki stability ke baare mein kya batata hai, aur fission aur fusion mein energy ke ikhraaj ki wazahat kaise karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Graph (Fig. 19.1) mein binding energy per nucleon ko nucleon number A ke muqable mein banaya jata hai. Is par nucleus ki jagah batati hai ke woh kitna stable hai aur us se fission ya fusion se energy mil sakti hai ya nahi.

Curve ki khusoosiyaat:
• Hydrogen nucleus (aik proton) ki binding energy zero hai.
• Hydrogen se helium tak bara farq hai, yani hydrogen ko helium banane se bohat energy nikalti hai.
• Curve iron-56 (⁵⁶₂₆Fe) par taqreeban 8.7 MeV per nucleon ki chouti tak pohanchta hai; yeh sab se stable nuclide hai; sab se stable nuclei A = 50 se 80 mein hain.
• Us ke baad binding energy per nucleon aahista aahista kam hoti hai.
Yani bohat halke aur bohat bhaari nuclei ki binding energy per nucleon kam hai.

Fission: Bhaari nucleus do darmiyani nuclei mein toote to products zyada mazbooti se bandhe (stable) hote hain aur energy nikalti hai.

Fusion: Do halke nuclei mil kar aik nucleus banayein to nucleons zyada mazboot bandhte hain; maslan deuterium aur tritium se helium banne par bohat energy nikalti hai. Is ke liye Suraj aur sitaron jaisa bohat zyada temperature chahiye.

Usool: jis nuclear reaction mein products ki binding energy per nucleon barhe, us se energy milti hai.

book_ref.quote: The position of a nucleus on this curve gives information about the stability of the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
6 Using the chapter's table of masses (proton 1.007276 u, neutron 1.008665 u, electron 0.00055 u, atomic mass of ⁷₃Li 7.016004 u), find the binding energy of the ⁷₃Li nucleus in MeV and its binding energy per nucleon. (1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J) (3 marks)
(Chapter ki masses wali table (proton 1.007276 u, neutron 1.008665 u, electron 0.00055 u, ⁷₃Li ka atomic mass 7.016004 u) se ⁷₃Li nucleus ki binding energy MeV mein aur binding energy per nucleon nikalein. (1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J))
blocks.explanation: Atomic mass se 3 electrons ka mass nikal kar nucleus ka mass lein, phir 3 protons aur 4 neutrons ke saath Eq. 19.1 aur Eq. 19.2 lagayein.

book_ref.quote: For your information: Some Atomic Masses

blocks.final_answer: ⁷₃Li ki B.E ≈ 39.3 MeV; taqreeban 5.62 MeV per nucleon

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Table mein lithium ka atomic mass hai jis mein 3 electrons bhi shamil hain, jabke proton ka mass akela diya gaya hai. Is liye pehle 3 electrons ka mass ghata kar sirf nucleus ka mass lena zaroori hai; warna mass defect ghalat aayega.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is nuclear fission? Describe the discovery of fission of uranium-235, write its equation, and use the binding energy curve to estimate the energy released per fission. (5 marks)
(Nuclear fission kya hai? Uranium-235 ke fission ki daryaft bayan karein, us ki equation likhein, aur binding energy curve se har fission ki energy ka andaza lagayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Jis reaction mein uranium jaisa bhaari nucleus taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei mein toote aur energy nikle, use fission kehte hain.

Daryaft: Otto Hahn aur Fritz Strassmann (Germany) ne dekha ke ²³⁵₉₂U par slow neutrons se ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba, ⁹²₃₆Kr aur ausatan teen neutrons bante hain. Yeh doosri reactions se do tarah mukhtalif thi: (1) barabar size ke do nuclei bante hain; (2) bohat zyada energy nikalti hai.

Equation:
²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba + ⁹²₃₆Kr + 3¹₀n + Q ... (19.3)
Dono taraf mass numbers (236) aur charge numbers (92) barabar hain. Kul energy ke muwazne se har fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV milti hai.

Curve se energy: Uranium ki binding energy per nucleon ~7.6 MeV, barium aur krypton ki ~8.5 MeV. Har nucleon par 0.9 MeV, 235 nucleons ke liye:
E = 235 × 0.9 = 211.5 MeV ≈ 200 MeV

Doosre fragments: fission hamesha Ba aur Kr nahi deta, maslan
²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹³²₅₀Sn + ¹⁰¹₄₂Mo + 3¹₀n + Q ... (19.4)
²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴⁰₅₄Xe + ⁹⁴₃₈Sr + 2¹₀n + Q ... (19.5)
Tamam fission fragments radioactive hain. Slow neutrons se fission uranium-235 aur plutonium-239 mein bohat aasani se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Otto Hahn and Fritz Strassmann of Germany

blocks.prompt:
8 Each fission of uranium-235 releases about 200 MeV. Find the total energy released when 1.0 g of uranium-235 undergoes complete fission. (Avogadro's number 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, molar mass of uranium-235 = 235 g mol⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J) (3 marks)
(Uranium-235 ka har fission taqreeban 200 MeV deta hai. 1.0 g uranium-235 ke mukammal fission se kul kitni energy niklegi? (Avogadro number 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, uranium-235 ka molar mass 235 g mol⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J))
blocks.explanation: 1 g mein nuclei ki tadaad nikalein, 200 MeV ko joules mein badlein, aur zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: By comparing the total energy on the left side of the equation

blocks.prompt:
9 What is a fission chain reaction? Explain critical mass and critical volume, and describe what happens when the mass of uranium is less than, equal to or much greater than the critical mass. How is the chain reaction controlled? (5 marks)
(Fission chain reaction kya hai? Critical mass aur critical volume ki wazahat karein, aur batayein ke uranium ka mass critical mass se kam, barabar ya bohat zyada ho to kya hota hai. Chain reaction kaise qaboo kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Chain reaction: Uranium-235 nucleus neutron jazb kar ke barabar mass ke do nuclei mein toot-ta hai aur do ya teen neutrons nikalta hai. Agar yeh neutrons mazeed atoms ka fission karein to reaction khud jaari rehta hai; yeh fission chain reaction hai. Be-qaboo ho to bohat kam waqt mein bohat energy aur bara dhamaka hota hai.

Size ka kirdaar (Fig. 19.4):
(a) Patli chadar mein neutrons hawa mein nikal jate hain; chain reaction nahi.
(b) Behtar halaat mein kuch neutrons sirf aik mazeed fission karte hain; phir bhi chain reaction nahi.
(c) Kaafi bare gol tukre mein zyada tar neutrons nikalne se pehle jazb ho kar chain reaction karte hain.

Critical mass: uranium ka woh mass jis mein aik fission ke tamam neutrons mein se aik neutron mazeed fission kare. Is ka hajm critical volume ya size hai.
• Critical se kam: chain reaction aage nahi barhta.
• Critical ke barabar: ibtidai raftar se chalta hai; mustaqil energy, atomic reactor mein.
• Critical se bohat zyada: tezi se barhta hai aur bara dhamaka; atom bomb isi par.

Qaboo: Reactor mein cadmium ki rods neutrons jazb karti hain aur khud radioactive nahi banteen. Inhein andar karne se fission ke liye neutrons kam ho jate hain, aur ausatan har fission ka sirf aik neutron agla fission karta hai; energy mustaqil raftar se nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: By properly using these neutrons, fission reaction can be produced in more uranium atoms

blocks.prompt:
10 A reactor runs on a controlled chain reaction and produces thermal power of 500 MW. If each fission releases 200 MeV, find (i) the number of fissions per second and (ii) the mass of uranium-235 used per day. (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, Avogadro's number 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, molar mass 235 g mol⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Aik reactor controlled chain reaction par 500 MW thermal power deta hai. Har fission 200 MeV de to (i) har second fissions ki tadaad aur (ii) aik din mein istemal hone wala uranium-235 ka mass nikalein. (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, Avogadro number 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, molar mass 235 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Power ko har fission ki energy se taqseem karein; din ke seconds se zarb de kar nuclei ko grams mein badlein.

book_ref.quote: In this way, the fission reaction is controlled.

blocks.final_answer: (i) 1.56 × 10¹⁹ fissions per second; (ii) taqreeban 527 g uranium-235 rozana

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe a nuclear power reactor. Explain the function of its core, moderator, control rods and heat exchanger, and describe how electricity is produced and how nuclear waste is stored. (5 marks)
(Nuclear power reactor ko bayan karein. Is ke core, moderator, control rods aur heat exchanger ka kaam batayein, aur bijli banne aur nuclear waste rakhne ka tareeqa bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Usool: Nuclear power station mein reactor thermal power station ki furnace ka kaam karta hai. Fission (har nucleus ~200 MeV) fragments ko kinetic energy deta hai jo takraon se heat banti hai. Heat se steam, steam se turbine aur turbine se generator chalta hai.

1. Core: sab se aham hissa jahan fuel cylindrical tubes mein hota hai. Fuel: 2.4-3.0% tak enriched uranium-235 (qudrati mein sirf 0.7%); aaj kal plutonium-239 aur uranium-233 bhi.

2. Moderator: fuel rods kam atomic weight wale maadde (paani ya heavy water, jo ²₁H se bana hai) mein hoti hain. Fission ke tez neutrons fission ke liye munasib nahi; moderator unhein slow karta hai.

3. Control rods: cadmium ya boron ki rods, jo slow (thermal) neutrons zyada jazb karti hain, core mein andar bahar ki jati hain taake sirf aik neutron agla fission kare. Emergency ya marammat mein rods gira kar chain reaction rok diya jata hai.

4. Heat exchanger: core ~500 °C tak garam hota hai. High pressure par paani, heavy water ya koi maa'e heat ko heat exchanger tak le jata hai jahan aam paani se garam steam banti hai. Turbine se nikalne wali steam (~300 °C) darya ya samandar ke paani se thandi kar ke wapis paani banayi jati hai.

Waste: fuel chand mahine chalta hai; istemal shuda fuel hazaron saal tak radioactive rehta hai. Ise samandar, mitti, hawa ya peene ke paani tak nahi pohanchna chahiye; behtareen jagah bohat khushk, hazaron meter gehri purani namak ki kaanein hain.

book_ref.quote: A reactor usually has four important parts. These are:

blocks.prompt:
12 A reactor core contains 2.0 kg of uranium-235. If the reactor's thermal power is 300 MW and each fission releases 200 MeV, how many days would it take to use up 10% of this uranium-235? (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, Avogadro's number 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, molar mass 235 g mol⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Reactor core mein 2.0 kg uranium-235 hai. Reactor ki thermal power 300 MW aur har fission 200 MeV ho to is uranium-235 ka 10% khatam hone mein kitne din lagenge? (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, Avogadro number 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, molar mass 235 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Fuel ke 10% mein nuclei, har second ke fissions nikal kar taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: When fission takes place in the atom of uranium or any other heavy atom

blocks.final_answer: Taqreeban 5.5 × 10⁴ s, yani taqreeban 0.63 din (15 ghante)

blocks.prompt:
13 What is nuclear fusion? Explain why energy is released in fusion and why fusion is difficult to produce. Write fusion reactions of deuterium and tritium and describe the methods used to produce fusion. (5 marks)
(Nuclear fusion kya hai? Wazahat karein ke fusion mein energy kyun nikalti hai aur fusion karwana mushkil kyun hai. Deuterium aur tritium ki fusion reactions likhein aur fusion paida karne ke tareeqe bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Jis nuclear reaction mein do halke nuclei mil kar bhaari nucleus banayein use fusion kehte hain.

Energy kyun: Binding energy curve ke mutabiq A = 50 tak binding energy per nucleon barhti hai. Do halke nuclei mil kar A < 50 wala nucleus banayein to kuch mass khatam ho kar energy ban jata hai. Fusion fission se zyada energy per nucleon deta hai.

Mushkil kyun: Dono nuclei positive hain. Unhein qareeb lane ke liye electrostatic repulsion ke khilaf kaam karna parta hai, is liye bohat zyada energy chahiye.

Reactions:
²₁H + ²₁H → ³₁H + ¹₁H + 4.0 MeV ... (19.6)
²₁H + ²₁H → ³₂He + ¹₀n + 3.3 MeV ... (19.7)
Har aik ~1.0 MeV per nucleon deti hai. Deuterium aur tritium (fusion fuels):
²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + ¹₀n + 17.6 MeV ... (19.8)

Tareeqe:
1. Accelerator: nuclei ko bohat tez raftar de kar takraya jata hai; research mein istemal, bare paimane par musalsal energy ke liye nahi.
2. Zyada temperature: temperature se atoms ki raftar barhti hai; ~10 million °C par halke nuclei ko zaroori raftar milti hai. Ise thermonuclear reaction kehte hain. Yeh temperature atom bomb ke dhamake mein thori der milta hai jo hydrogen bomb ko shuru karta hai.

Fusion abhi fission ki tarah qaboo mein nahi, is liye bijli nahi banti; yeh Suraj samet sitaron ke markaz mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The curve of the graph in Fig. 19.1 also shows that the binding energy per nucleon increases up to A = 50.

blocks.prompt:
14 In the fusion ²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + ¹₀n + 17.6 MeV, find (i) the energy released in joules, (ii) the mass converted into energy and (iii) the energy per nucleon, and compare it with the 0.9 MeV per nucleon of fission. (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Fusion ²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + ¹₀n + 17.6 MeV mein (i) joules mein energy, (ii) energy mein badalne wala mass aur (iii) energy per nucleon nikalein, aur fission ke 0.9 MeV per nucleon se muwazna karein. (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: MeV ko J mein badlein, Δm = E/c² lagayein, aur 17.6 MeV ko 5 nucleons se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: During a fusion reaction some mass is lost and its equivalent energy is given out.

blocks.final_answer: (i) 2.82 × 10⁻¹² J; (ii) 3.13 × 10⁻²⁹ kg; (iii) 3.52 MeV per nucleon, fission se taqreeban 3.9 guna

blocks.prompt:
15 Define activity and its SI unit. Show that the number of atoms decaying in a short interval is ΔN = −λNΔt, explain the meaning of the decay constant, and obtain the relation between activity and decay constant. (5 marks)
(Activity aur us ki SI unit ki definition likhein. Dikhayein ke chhote waqfe mein decay hone wale atoms ΔN = −λNΔt hain, decay constant ka matlab samjhayein, aur activity aur decay constant ka relation hasil karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Random decay: α ya β-particle nikalne par element doosre element mein badal jata hai. Decay random hai: kisi khaas atom ka waqt nahi bataya ja sakta, magar bohat bara sample aik tarteeb par chalta hai.

Activity: radioactive maadde se har second nikalne wale particles ki tadaad. SI unit: becquerel, 1 Bq = 1 decay per second. Detector ka count rate activity ke seedha mutanasib hai.

Decay law: Agar kisi waqt N atoms hon to chhote waqfe Δt mein decay hone wale ΔN, Δt aur N dono ke mutanasib hain. N kam hota hai, is liye
ΔN ∝ −NΔt
ΔN = −λNΔt ... (19.9)
λ tanasub ka constant, yani decay constant hai.

λ ka matlab: λ = −(ΔN/N)/Δt har unit time mein decay hone wale atoms ka hissa hai; unit s⁻¹. Bara λ, zyada decay. Minus sign N ki kami dikhata hai.

Activity aur λ: Eq. 19.9 ko Δt se taqseem karne par
ΔN/Δt = −λN
Activity har second ke decays ki (positive) tadaad hai, is liye
A = −ΔN/Δt = λN ... (19.10)
Yani activity undecayed nuclei ki tadaad ke mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: We can represent these results with an equation.

blocks.prompt:
16 A sample of sodium-24 (half-life 15 hours, molar mass 24 g mol⁻¹) has a mass of 2.0 μg. Find (i) the number of nuclei, (ii) the decay constant and (iii) the activity of the sample. (Avogadro's number 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Sodium-24 (half-life 15 ghante, molar mass 24 g mol⁻¹) ke sample ka mass 2.0 μg hai. (i) nuclei ki tadaad, (ii) decay constant aur (iii) sample ki activity nikalein. (Avogadro number 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Mass aur molar mass se nuclei; T½ seconds mein le kar λ = 0.693/T½; phir A = λN.

book_ref.quote: Its sample of mass 5.1 μg is found to have an activity

blocks.prompt:
17 Define half-life. Show that after n half-lives the number of undecayed atoms is (1/2)ⁿN₀ and the number decayed is N₀(1 − 1/2ⁿ). What two conclusions follow about radioactive decay? (5 marks)
(Half-life ki definition likhein. Dikhayein ke n half-lives baad undecayed atoms (1/2)ⁿN₀ aur decay shuda N₀(1 − 1/2ⁿ) hain. Radioactive decay ke baare mein kaunse do nataij nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: Sample ki activity ko kisi bhi ibtidai qeemat se aadha hone mein jo waqt lage woh half-life T½ hai. Har element ki apni half-life hai, maslan uranium-238 4.5 × 10⁹ saal, radium-226 1620 saal, radon 3.8 din, uranium-239 23.5 minute.

Baqi atoms: Shuru mein N₀ atoms hon (decay curve, Fig. 19.7).
Aik half-life baad: N₀/2
Do half-lives baad: ½ × N₀/2 = (1/2)²N₀
Teen half-lives baad: (1/2)³N₀
n half-lives baad: N = (1/2)ⁿN₀

Decay shuda atoms:
Pehli half-life baad = N₀ − N₀/2 = N₀/2
Doosri half-life baad = N₀ − N₀/4 = 3N₀/4
Teesri half-life baad = N₀ − N₀/8 = 7N₀/8
n half-lives baad: N₀(1 − 1/2ⁿ) ... (19.11)

Nataij:
1. Koi radioactive element poori tarah decay nahi hota: har half-life mein sirf aadhe baqi nuclei decay hote hain, is liye la-mehdood waqt chahiye.
2. Kisi muddat mein decay hone wale atoms us muddat ke shuru mein maujood atoms ke mutanasib hain.

book_ref.quote: After a period of one half-life N₀ / 2 number of atoms of this radioactive element are left behind.

blocks.prompt:
18 Iodine-131 has a half-life of 8 days. A sample initially contains 4800 atoms of iodine-131. Find (i) the number of atoms left and (ii) the number decayed after 32 days, and (iii) the percentage left. (3 marks)
(Iodine-131 ki half-life 8 din hai. Sample mein shuru mein iodine-131 ke 4800 atoms hain. 32 din baad (i) baqi atoms, (ii) decay shuda atoms aur (iii) baqi ka percentage nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: 32 din mein half-lives ginein, phir N = (1/2)ⁿN₀ aur decay shuda = N₀(1 − 1/2ⁿ) lagayein.

book_ref.quote: If there are 1000 atoms of polonium initially present in a sample

blocks.prompt:
19 Write the exponential law of radioactive decay. Using it, obtain the relation between half-life and decay constant, and explain what the decay curve shows. Also explain how artificial radioactive elements are made. (5 marks)
(Radioactive decay ka exponential qanoon likhein. Is se half-life aur decay constant ka relation hasil karein, aur decay curve kya dikhata hai batayein. Artificial radioactive elements banane ka tareeqa bhi bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Exponential qanoon: Radioactive element ka decay us ki half-life ya decay constant λ se bayan hota hai. Calculus se, waqt t ke baad undecayed nuclei
N = N₀e^(−λt) ... (19.12)
jahan N₀ ibtidai nuclides hain.

Half-life: Jab N = N₀/2 ho to t = T½:
N₀/2 = N₀e^(−λT½)
e^(λT½) = 2
λT½ = ln 2 = 0.693
T½ = 0.693/λ ... (19.13)
Yani λ maloom ho to half-life nikal sakti hai; bara λ, chhoti half-life.

Decay curve: Maujood atoms aur time ka graph N₀ se shuru ho kar har half-life baad N₀/2, N₀/4, N₀/8, … tak girta hai aur kabhi zero nahi hota. Har element is curve par chalta hai magar har aik ki half-life mukhtalif hai.

Artificial radioactive elements: Kisi stable element par bohat tez energy wale particles ki bombardment se us ke nuclei excite ho kar unstable aur radioactive ban jate hain; yeh artificial radioactive elements hain.

book_ref.quote: When N reduces to N₀/2, t is known as half-life

blocks.prompt:
21 What are radioactive tracers? Explain the tracer technique and describe the uses of radioisotopes in medical diagnosis and treatment and in agriculture. (5 marks)
(Radioactive tracers kya hain? Tracer technique ki wazahat karein aur tibbi tashkhees (diagnosis), ilaaj aur zaraat mein radioisotopes ke istemal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Tracer: Radioactive isotope zinda jism mein aam isotope jaisa bartao karta hai, magar is ki radiation naap kar is ki jagah aur miqdaar maloom hoti hai. Is liye yeh tracer ban kar chemical ya biological amal ka peecha karta hai.

Technique: maadde mein stable atoms ki jagah usi qism ke radioactive atoms daal kar detector se 'tagged' atoms ka peecha kiya jata hai. Radioisotopes neutrons ki bombardment se aasani aur kam qeemat mein bante hain.

Tashkhees:
• Tracers hazme (digestion) aur jism mein chemicals ki harkat dikhate hain. Radio-iodine thyroid mein, phosphorus haddiyon mein, cobalt jigar mein jata hai.
• Kam activity ki dose se thyroid ka kaam check hota hai; bimar ya hyperactive gland normal se do guna se zyada leta hai.
• Sodium-24 se khoon ki gardish. Table 19.1: sodium-24 (15 ghante) plasma volume, iron-59 (45 din) plasma mein iron, technetium-99m (6 ghante) thyroid uptake scans.

Ilaaj:
• Tezi se barhne wale cancer cells zyada radiation jazb kar ke aasani se khatam hote hain. Iodine-131 thyroid cancer ke khilaf.
• 'Seed' kehlane wale capsules malignant tissue mein lagaye jate hain; skin cancer ke liye phosphorus-32 ya strontium-90, dose ehtiyat se.

Zaraat aur research: fertilizer mein thora radioisotope mila kar paude ka liya hua fertilizer naapa jata hai; radiation mutations se behtar chawal, chana, gandum aur kapas. Chemistry aur biology mein mushkil reactions ka amal samjha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: A radioactive isotope behaves in just the same way as the normal isotope inside a living organism.

blocks.prompt:
23 What is annihilation of matter? Explain the annihilation of an electron-positron pair and why two photons are produced. Describe how high energy collisions at CERN's Large Hadron Collider are used in particle research. (5 marks)
(Maadde ki annihilation kya hai? Electron-positron pair ki annihilation aur do photons banne ki wajah samjhayein. CERN ke Large Hadron Collider ke high energy takrao particle research mein kaise kaam aate hain, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Annihilation: jab koi particle aur us ka antiparticle qareeb aayein to dono khatam ho kar apna mass Einstein ke relation se energy mein badal dete hain.

Electron-positron pair: electron aur positron (har aik 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg) annihilate hote hain. Energy
E = 2mc²
taqreeban 1.02 MeV banti hai (Example 19.4).
Do photons: saakin pair ka kul momentum zero hai. Is liye do γ-ray photons, har aik 0.51 MeV, mukhalif simt mein jate hain aur kul momentum zero rehta hai (momentum ka tahaffuz).

High energy takrao: particle research ke liye bohat zyada energy chahiye. Particles ko roshni ki raftar ke qareeb tez kar ke takraya jata hai. CERN ke LHC mein protons ko protons se, aur bhaari nuclei ko aapas mein, TeV ke darje ki energy par takraya jata hai, jis se ibtidai kainaat jaise halaat bante hain (CMS mein 7 TeV proton-proton takrao se 100 se zyada charged particles bane).

Daryaftein: electro-weak force ke W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons ki peshgoi Prof. Abdus Salam ne ki; LHC ki sab se aham daryaft Higgs boson hai, July 2012 mein.

book_ref.quote: In elementary particles research, very high energies are required for investigations.
